# Kellmarks community

## Where to participate

Use [Issues](https://github.com/paulkakell/kellmarks/issues/new/choose) for reproducible bugs, concrete feature requests, and documentation improvements. The forms request the information needed to evaluate each report. General contributors are directed to the forms rather than a blank issue.

Use [Discussions](https://github.com/paulkakell/kellmarks/discussions) for questions, early ideas, and sharing workflows. Keep conversations respectful, search before posting, and link related issues instead of duplicating them. In Q&A, mark the helpful reply as the answer when your question is resolved.

Do not post tokens, private bookmarks, complete data files, personal filesystem paths, or unredacted logs and screenshots. Use synthetic examples and example.com URLs. Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for vulnerability reporting; public issues and discussions are not the place for exploit details.

Code contributions follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and target `dev`.

## Discussion categories and forms

Discussions was already enabled when these files were added. Category configuration and live form rendering could not be inspected through the connected tools. The files below target these expected category slugs; adding a file does not create a category.

| Category | Format | Form filename |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Announcements | Announcement | `announcements.yml` |
| Q&A | Question and answer | `q-a.yml` |
| Ideas | Open-ended discussion | `ideas.yml` |
| Show and tell | Open-ended discussion | `show-and-tell.yml` |
| General | Open-ended discussion | `general.yml` |

A maintainer should open Discussions, edit the categories, and confirm or create the categories above without deleting existing conversations. Match the filenames in `.github/DISCUSSION_TEMPLATE/` to the actual category URL slugs. Keep Announcements in the announcement format and Q&A in the question-and-answer format. Open a new discussion in each category to confirm its form renders; test drafts do not need to be published.

### Suggested pinned welcome discussion

The text below is ready to post in General and pin. It has not been posted automatically.

> **Welcome to Kellmarks Discussions!**
>
> This is the place to ask questions, explore ideas, and share how you organize your bookmarks.
>
> Choose Q&A for installation and usage help, Ideas for early proposals, and Show and tell for workflows and customizations. Watch Announcements for maintainer updates. Use the issue forms for reproducible bugs, concrete feature requests, and documentation improvements.
>
> Search before posting, be respectful, and never share private bookmarks, tokens, or unredacted logs. Follow SECURITY.md for vulnerabilities. When a Q&A reply solves your problem, mark it as the answer.

## Sponsorship setup

`.github/FUNDING.yml` selects the repository owner, `paulkakell`, as the GitHub Sponsors recipient. No third-party payment account is assumed or configured.

This file does not enroll an account in GitHub Sponsors, create payment tiers, or prove that a live Sponsor button is visible. Those account and repository settings could not be verified through the connected tools.

To finish verification, confirm that `paulkakell` has an approved GitHub Sponsors profile, then open repository **Settings > General > Features** and enable **Sponsorships** if necessary. Check that the repository Sponsor button resolves to the intended recipient. If a different funding platform is intended, replace the destination with a verified account rather than a placeholder.

## Maintainer verification

Issue and discussion forms must be on the default branch (`main`) to take effect. Check the New issue chooser and each discussion category without submitting test posts. The issue forms request the standard `bug`, `enhancement`, and `documentation` labels; confirm these labels exist if automatic labeling is desired. No assignees or project boards are automatically assigned.

GitHub references: [issue forms](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/using-templates-to-encourage-useful-issues-and-pull-requests/syntax-for-issue-forms), [discussion category forms](https://docs.github.com/en/discussions/managing-discussions-for-your-community/syntax-for-discussion-category-forms), and [sponsor button configuration](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/displaying-a-sponsor-button-in-your-repository).
